feature_area: Channel Info panel (Info RHS) - opened via channel header button 'View Info' or channel menu item 'View Info'

target_release.licence: Licensed via MM_LICENSE, passed through Compose by name only at runtime (infra/docker-compose.yml:53); no licence value or length is recorded. IsLicensed === 'true' is required: an unlicensed server is a setup failure (run-pilot.sh step_stack :148-153). MM_SERVICEENVIRONMENT=test is set on the pilot Mattermost container only (infra/docker-compose.yml:37-38), user-approved because the licence is test-signed. The pilot asserts no licensed feature; neither scenario depends on the licence.
target_release.network: Internal-only Docker network (internal: true), no published ports, loopback-only forwarder 127.0.0.1:8065 -> Mattermost container. DIRECT: container network membership, no published ports, Postgres has no default route, forwarder loopback-only, IsLicensed. INFERRED: the Mattermost container's own egress boundary (distroless, not exec'd). Source: infra/README.md:30-42.
target_release.drift: Pinned checkout is f88f88c (master, unreleased 12.2.0); the tested server is the 12.1.0 release image. 13 related files changed between v12.1.0 and f88f88c (+520/-266: channel_info_rhs/, sidebar_right.tsx, channel_info_button.tsx, header_icon_wrapper.tsx). Untagged source citations are for 12.2.0 and may differ in the running UI. Both scenarios were re-checked against both versions (ledger and independent verifier). Behaviour on a 12.2.0 server is not verified.
target_release.note: Pinned checkout is master (version 12.2.0, unreleased). Both selected scenarios were re-checked against v12.1.0 source; see coverage.md section 9. The earlier team-edition, unlicensed recommendation was not what ran and is withdrawn.

scenarios.title: Open Info panel follows the newly selected channel after a sidebar channel switch
techniques: equivalence partitioning (seeded distinct value classes per channel)
scenarios.risk_behavior_under_test: Stale-panel regression. The Info RHS keeps rhsState=CHANNEL_INFO and a selectedChannelId captured when it was opened (actions/views/rhs.ts:524-530, reducers/views/rhs.ts:107), but renders getCurrentChannel (channel_info_rhs/index.ts:39). switchToChannel re-targets the Pinned and Files RHS views to the new channel (actions/global_actions.tsx:88, :92) but does nothing for Info, and SidebarRight does not close the RHS on a same-team channel change (sidebar_right.tsx:240-253). The panel content following the new channel therefore depends on an implicit coupling that no e2e test pins down. A regression would show channel A's purpose/header/handle while the user is in channel B.

closest_cypress.asserts: From the Members sub-view, switching to a DM leaves the RHS title 'Info' visible (:111). Asserts only the static title text.
Members RHS opened from header #member_rhs (:120-121), switch to a DM (:127), #sidebar-right does not exist (:130).
closest_cypress.does_not_prove: Info is never opened, the target is a DM, and the assertion is that the RHS closes; nothing about Info content following the new channel.

closest_cypress.asserts: Open via #channel-info-btn; helper :536-541 checks 'Info' and the subtitle contains the display name, for a single channel, no transition.
Purpose patched via API while the panel is open appears in the RHS (single channel, live update).
Header patched via API appears in the RHS (single channel).

closest_playwright.asserts: MM-T880: header saved via intro modal is visible in the Info RHS opened from channel menu 'View Info' (:89-94). Single channel.
Name, purpose, handle, ID for one channel; mute; settings modal. No channel switch.
openChannelInfo() clicks #channel-info-btn only if getByText('Info', {exact: true}) is not already visible in the RHS.
closest_playwright.does_not_prove: It skips the click when Info text is already visible, so it never exercises a channel switch with the panel open; no Playwright spec asserts Info content after a switch.

scenarios.remaining_gap: No spec opens Info, switches channel in-app and then asserts the new channel's Info content (display name/purpose/header/handle) AND the absence of the previous channel's values. CY-32 asserts only the fixed title 'Info' after a Members-to-DM switch; CY-38 (channel_members_rhs_spec.ts:116-130) asserts only that the RHS closes when switching to a DM; the Playwright openChannelInfo() helper skips the click if Info text is already visible.

risks_of_flakiness: Sidebar link name gains ' unread' if release-planning has unseen posts; mitigated by the final view call and no later posts. Engine must not fall back to a regex. The release-purpose-changed control posts a system message and must re-mark the channels viewed before replay.
Center channel header also renders 'Release header bravo-91d2'; every text assertion must be scoped to region 'Info'.
The about area and subtitle render from Redux immediately, but use auto-waiting expect (default 5s+) rather than snapshot timing.
Onboarding tours can cover the sidebar for a new user; mitigated by the four seeded preferences.
If a future build closes the RHS on channel switch, the test fails on 'region Info visible'; that is a product change to be triaged, not flake.

scenarios.title: Archived public channel: Info panel shows the archived notice and is read-only for a regular member
techniques: decision table (channel type x archived x role/permission x content present)
equivalence partitioning (archived vs active public channel)
scenarios.risk_behavior_under_test: Authorization/UX gating driven by real server state. After a channel is archived (delete_at != 0 from the server), the panel must show 'This channel is archived.', must hide Add People, every Edit affordance (rename, purpose, header), Notification Preferences and Channel Settings, must NOT offer 'Unarchive' to a user without manage_team, and must still show the seeded purpose/header read-only. Currently only Jest unit tests with mocked props cover this (channel_info_rhs.test.tsx:74, menu.test.tsx:98, :291); no e2e test opens Info on an archived channel.

closest_cypress.asserts: MM-T1717: after archiving, the channel header DROPDOWN hides Archive, Channel Settings and Notification Preferences and keeps Members. Does not open the Info RHS.
Add People absent in the Info RHS for a user whose channel_user role lost manage_*_members (permission cause, active channel). Does not check Edit, notice or menu items.
Channel menu lists 'View Info' (and others) for an active channel.
MM-T1719: user created with promoteNewUserAsAdmin: true (:16) archives the channel (:32), opens header dropdown #channelMembers (:38), and findByText('Manage') does not exist in the RHS (:41).
closest_cypress.does_not_prove: Members view, not the Info panel; the user is a system admin, not a regular member; checks only the 'Manage' text (no archived notice, Add People, Edit, menu items or Unarchive).

closest_playwright.asserts: Archives (:316) then unarchives (:326) a channel as setup only; Info is opened on the ACTIVE channel to check attribute locking.

MM-T1671: regular user from pw.initSetup() (lib/src/server/init.ts:40-42) archives the channel (:19), opens channel menu Members (:22-24), sees the admin in the list (:27), and Manage/Add buttons are not visible (:30-31; locators sidebar_right.ts:67-68).
closest_playwright.does_not_prove: Members view, not the Info panel; no archived notice, Add People, Edit, Notification Preferences, Channel Settings or Unarchive checks in Info.

scenarios.remaining_gap: No spec (main or open PR) opens the Info panel of an archived channel as a non-admin. The archived-notice text, the absence of Add People/Edit/Notification Preferences/Channel Settings in the panel, the absence of Unarchive for a non-team-admin, and the preservation of read-only purpose/header are unproven end-to-end. The Members-view read-only behaviour on archived channels is covered by MM-T1671 (PW-26) and Cypress archive_channel_member_spec (CY-37), but that is a different panel; CY-33 covers the header dropdown. 'This channel is archived' has 0 hits under e2e-tests/ (rg -uu -i and git grep, re-run for this ledger).
